seo.title: Vera — how we predict where your consumer will search | Advia
seo.description: Vera simulates synthetic consumers who go through the decision before yours does, and returns the places where your brand can be the answer.

titular: Vera knows what your consumer is going to ask, and <key>where</key>
lede: By observing the journeys of their Active Navigation, so you can capitalise on them.
cabecera: Vera uses agents that simulate how your consumers behave

pasos.desc: Sociodemographic profile, decision factors and decision context.
pasos.eco: The profile sets their needs; the factors, the questions they ask themselves

pasos.desc: The same ones any of us use to search: search engines, platforms and models.
pasos.eco: If they search with the same tools as your consumers, they behave like them

pasos.desc: Every possible behaviour within Active Navigation.
pasos.eco: The places where your brand can be the answer show up

pie: Every journey is unique, but the stops are finite. Vera uncovers the map of your consumers' Active Navigation and turns it into inventory you can activate.
door: Find out how to capitalise on the Active Navigation map

cierre.lede: We show you the map of questions your target asks about a real category, and the places where you can answer them.
